question: Which of the following ritual dances is performed by the Kamar tribe of Madhya Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tertali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Kamar tribe of Madhya Pradesh** performs the **Tertali dance,** a ritual dance that blends various dance forms.
 
• Typically, two or three women partake in the dance, sitting on the ground and possibly wearing veils.
 
• They may also hold small swords in their teeth and carry ornamental pots on their heads.
 
• **Cymbals and Sirpa instruments** accompany the performance. Living in the forests, valleys, and hills of central India, the Kamar tribe primarily resides in the Raipur and Rewa districts of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• They are divided into endogamous clans, or gots, restricting marriage within the clan for cultural preservation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Ghapal, **a folk dance originating from Rajasthan, India, holds significance as a peripheral folk dance of the region.
 
• **Munari,** another folk dance, hails from the state of Odisha, India. Odisha boasts additional folk dances like Savari, Ghumara, and Painka.
 
• **Paika dance, **a martial folk dance, originates from the Chotanagpur plateau region, spanning across Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, and Odisha.
